name: How long does it usually take to repair a dragging sliding door?

mainEntity.name: How long does it usually take to repair a dragging sliding door?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for a sliding door repair depends on the complexity of the issue. Simple fixes, such as cleaning tracks or replacing a few rollers, might take anywhere from one to two hours. More involved repairs, like correcting significant alignment problems, replacing a damaged track, or addressing structural issues, could take half a day or longer. Most standard dragging door repairs are completed within a few hours. A technician can provide a more accurate time estimate after diagnosing the problem.
